description: Couverture internet fixe par commune et par département (agrégation ARCEP) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comparateur Internet. Municipal and departmental aggregation of fixed internet coverage in France, calculated from ARCEP's "My Internet Connection" dataset, vintage T1 2026. What these files add to the source: Coverage rates calculated for each technology (fiber FttH, coaxial cable, copper, 4G fixed, THD radio, satellite), where the source provides only eligible premises. Coverage: Comparateur Internet. The portal shows the English title as "Fixed internet coverage by municipality and department (ARCEP aggregation)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Comparateur Internet. Its keywords include amenagement-du-territoire, fibre-optique, tres-haut-debit, departement, commune, couverture-numerique. The listing shows 3 download or service links in MD, CSV. The listing shows 2026-08-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
